title: Shallow Encoding Emits Deep Memories
abstract: arXiv:2611.06084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave a few softmax-attention layers with many linear-attention or state-space layers, so every layer keeps a memory of earlier tokens: a key-value cache or a fixed-size recurrent state. Serving them spends more compute and high-bandwidth memory on these memories than the output requires. The prefill runs every layer for every prompt token, and every decode step loads and stores whole recurrent states, which on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next take as many bytes per request as the attention cache of thousands of tokens. We find two properties of trained hybrids that locate this excess. First, writes are easier than reads: writing a deep layer's memory of a token needs little of the deep computation that predicting the next token needs. translated_title: 浅层编码释放深层记忆
translated_abstract: 混合语言模型将少数softmax注意力层与大量线性注意力层或状态空间层交错排列，因此每一层都保存着先前词元的记忆：键值缓存或固定大小的循环状态。在推理服务中，这些记忆所消耗的计算量和高速带宽内存超过了实际输出所需。预填充阶段需要对每个提示词元运行所有层，而每个解码步骤都需要加载和存储完整的循环状态——在Qwen3.8-Flash-Next上，这相当于每个请求要消耗数千词元注意力缓存所占用的字节数。我们发现了训练后的混合模型的两个特性，可以定位这种冗余开销。首先，写入比读取更容易：写入某一深层对某个词元的记忆，所需的深层计算远少于预测下一个词元所需的计算。因此，我们利用深层写入路径的训练副本（称为“发射器”emitters），从较浅的锚定层的残差流中写出提示的深层记忆，并且所有提示词元……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了“发射器”机制——即深层写入路径的训练副本，能够从较浅的锚定层残差流中直接写出深层记忆，从而大幅降低混合语言模型推理服务中的计算与内存开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes "emitters" — trained copies of deep layers' write paths that can write deep-layer memories directly from a shallower anchor layer's residual stream, significantly reducing compute and memory overhead when serving hybrid language models.
